protocol.training_arm: routePCadam replay only; no new arm

d2_reconciliation.evaluation_fact: D2 identity is the held-out global vector (all four recurrent layers plus readout) at RouteA final parameters, seeds 0--4. Bridge identity is lower recurrent layers L0--L2 only at RoutePCAdam final parameters, seeds 0--14. Both are K=1500 and use held-out batches 4--7 from PRNG 888000+seed.
